parsing.notes: BLOCKED (token). CAC Beneficial Ownership Register (PSC). API borapp.cac.gov.ng/api/bor-search/get_psc (POST) returns 401 without an access token. Do NOT bypass the token gate. SECURITY NOTE: a token-less /auth/access-token endpoint returned an individual's PII (broken access control) — do NOT call it, use it, or store its output. PSC names/nationality are personal data (NDPA 2023) — redact. Join on RC number / company name to the CAC register.
